summary: Embraer S.A., via Form 6-K, announced its Board of Directors declared Interest on Equity (IoE) for Q3 FY2026, totaling R$154 million, or R$0.21634283532 per share. The IoE is imputed to mandatory dividends, ad referendum of the Annual Shareholders' Meeting. Record date is September 21, 2026 on B3; ex-date September 22 on B3 and September 23 on NYSE. Payment occurs May 24, 2027, without adjustment. ADS holders receive via JPMorgan. No premium, price, or deal structure—this is a routine capital return, not a tender or special action. Watch for final per-share adjustment due to treasury share changes.
